description: Offering id: {institution}_{course_code_raw}_{year}_{semester}_{status}, with the semester in English (spring, autumn, summer). An offering keeps the id it was first harvested under when a later DBH snapshot changes its status.
Short name of the institution in the harvest ("oslomet", "uia"); several DBH codes can map to one (INN: 0264 and 1177).
DBH's institution code ("0256").
DBH's institution name.
DBH's code of the unit (faculty or department) that offers the course.
Name of the unit.
Statistics Norway's code of the unit; NA in some years.
Calendar year of the semester.
Semester code: 0 winter, 1 spring, 2 summer, 3 autumn.
Semester in Norwegian: "Vinter", "Vår", "Sommer", "Høst".
The study programme DBH registers the course under in this semester (one per row); unique only within an institution.
Name of the programme.
DBH's course code, with its version number ("LMUKHV10421-1").
Course code without a trailing version number ("LMUKHV10421"): the code plans are kept by.
Course name as DBH registers it.
Level of the course: LN lower degree level, HN higher degree level, AR one-year programme, VS upper secondary level, 50 an older code without a name, and others in DBH (FU, B3, M2, ...).
Name of the level; NA for code 50.
ECTS credits.
Statistics Norway's standard classification of education (NUS), six digits; "999999" unknown.
Course status: 0 no data, 1 active, 2 new, 3 discontinued, 4 discontinued with active students (exams still held).
Status in Norwegian ("Aktivt", "Nytt", "Avviklet", "Avviklet med aktive studenter", "Ikke data").
Language of instruction as DBH registers it: "NOR", "ENG", "SME", ...; "999" unknown; a few in lower case ("nob").
Name of the language of instruction ("Norsk", "Engelsk", "Ukjent").
Subject (fag) code of the course ("KUNST"); NA for some courses.
Name of the subject ("Kunst og Håndverk").
Whether the course is a thesis: 0 no, 1 a bachelor's thesis or project, 2 a master's (or hovedfag) thesis. Registered from autumn 2012, and for some earlier courses.

How the year of the offering's plan is known: "url" the page's URL holds the year; "page" one page holds the plans of several years (NLA); "current" the site shows only the plan in force, so a page is the plan of the academic year it was fetched in.
The offering's plan in course_plans (with institution and course_code); NA when the offering has no plan. A SHA-256 hash of course_plan_normalized, so offerings with the same plan text share it.
Date of the harvest of the offering's row (recorded since 2026-10-06, else NA); at a site that shows only the current plan, the date of the harvest whose page the offering takes.
NLA only: the academic year ("2023-2024") whose part of the course page holds the offering's plan; NA elsewhere.
Whether text was read from the offering's page.
Characters of the text read from the page, before anonymization; NA without text.
Plan id: a SHA-256 hash of course_plan_normalized. A plan is a plan_content_id, institution and course_code.
As in course_offerings.
As in course_offerings.
First year of the offerings with this plan (double up to data-2026-10-16).
Last year of the offerings with this plan (double up to data-2026-10-16).
The plan's earliest offering: course_plan and the sections are read from its page.
The plan's text, anonymized (course_plan_spec.md).
course_plan lower-cased, without structural headings and labels, whitespace squished (normalize_plan_text()): the text the id is made from. Not for reading.
As in course_plans.
As in course_offerings.
As in course_offerings.
As in course_plans.
One of seven sections (section_codebook.yml): course_content, learning_outcomes, prerequisites, teaching_methods, coursework_requirements, assessment, reading_list.
The section's text, anonymized.
